guided_attempts_self_report_only.name: guided_attempts_self_report_only
guided_attempts_self_report_only.value: ("learning"."guided_attempts"."submitted_at" IS NULL AND "learning"."guided_attempts"."completion_provenance" IS NULL) OR ("learning"."guided_attempts"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "learning"."guided_attempts"."completion_provenance" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'SELF_REPORTED')

real_lab_system_verification.name: real_lab_system_verification
real_lab_system_verification.value:
CASE WHEN "real_lab"."checks"."configuration_ok" AND "real_lab"."checks"."response_ok"
    THEN "real_lab"."checks"."completion_provenance" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'SYSTEM_VERIFIED'
    ELSE "real_lab"."checks"."completion_provenance" IS NULL END

concept_bilingual_copy.name: concept_bilingual_copy
concept_bilingual_copy.value:
length(btrim("knowledge"."concepts"."title_en")) BETWEEN 1 AND 120
    AND length(btrim("knowledge"."concepts"."title_ar")) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND length(btrim("knowledge"."concepts"."summary_en")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1200
    AND length(btrim("knowledge"."concepts"."summary_ar")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1200

lab_concepts_kind.name: lab_concepts_kind
lab_concepts_kind.value:
("knowledge"."lab_concepts"."course_slug" IS NOT NULL AND "knowledge"."lab_concepts"."lab_id" IS NOT NULL AND "knowledge"."lab_concepts"."real_template_version" IS NULL)
    OR ("knowledge"."lab_concepts"."course_slug" IS NULL AND "knowledge"."lab_concepts"."lab_id" IS NULL AND "knowledge"."lab_concepts"."real_template_version" = 'nginx-reverse-proxy@1'
      AND "knowledge"."lab_concepts"."real_template_version" IS NOT NULL)

interview_message_position.name: interview_message_position
interview_message_position.value:
"interview"."messages"."position" BETWEEN 0 AND 7 AND
    (("interview"."messages"."position" % 2 = 0 AND "interview"."messages"."speaker" = 'interviewer') OR ("interview"."messages"."position" % 2 = 1 AND "interview"."messages"."speaker" = 'learner'))

interview_budgets.name: interview_budgets
interview_budgets.value:
"interview"."sessions"."turns" BETWEEN 0 AND 4 AND
    "interview"."sessions"."input_reserved" BETWEEN 0 AND 65536 AND "interview"."sessions"."output_reserved" BETWEEN 0 AND 6144

interview_completion.name: interview_completion
interview_completion.value:
("interview"."sessions"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "interview"."sessions"."scorecard_json" IS NULL)
    OR ("interview"."sessions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "interview"."sessions"."scorecard_json" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("interview"."sessions"."scorecard_json") = 'object' AND "interview"."sessions"."turns" > 0)

interview_lease.name: interview_lease
interview_lease.value:
("interview"."sessions"."lease_id" IS NULL AND "interview"."sessions"."lease_until" IS NULL AND "interview"."sessions"."lease_operation" IS NULL)
    OR ("interview"."sessions"."lease_id" IS NOT NULL AND "interview"."sessions"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL AND "interview"."sessions"."lease_operation" IS NOT NULL
      AND "interview"."sessions"."lease_operation" IN ('start','message','evaluate'))
